work.name: Overjet
work.summary: Served as a core product engineer and technical lead for a 6-engineer Provider Network Management (PNM) squad, driving the end-to-end modernization of both frontend and backend stacks while delivering critical credentialing and payer enrollment workflows.
highlights: Served as Technical Lead for the migration to a 'Provider-first' architecture, centralizing data ownership to eliminate sync complexity and unblocking the Q1 launch for 3 major Payers.
Secured a major partnership by shipping a production-ready Public API in one week, replacing fragile Express routes with a type-safe Hono/Arktype architecture.
Slashed test execution time by 60% by migrating from serial Dockerized Postgres containers to parallelized Pglite instances, enabling fully isolated local debugging for the team.
Architected a scalable frontend foundation by introducing GraphQL to efficiently handle complex credentialing data, while refactoring monolithic components into idiomatic, hook-optimized React.
Consolidated fragmented Python/Go services into a unified TypeScript monolith, eliminating infrastructure boilerplate and restoring synchronous data consistency

work.name: Medallion

highlights: Pioneered GraphQL integration, migrating REST endpoints and cultivating an active community to improve dev velocity.
Built a high-throughput provider import pipeline using Celery and Customer.io, decreasing turnaround times by 30%.
Integrated real-time verifications using Celerybeat/Pusher, ensuring compliance while streamlining operations.

work.name: American Express
